work_items.title: Geo proxy: GET /geo/suggest (Photon) + GET /geo/route (OSRM)
work_items.goal: Two DispatcherOnly server-side geo proxies — address autocomplete and route distance/duration — resilient to upstream failure. Registered via GeoFeatureConfiguration.AddFeatureDependencies (typed HttpClient), so no Program.cs edit.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/geo/suggest?q= is DispatcherOnly, returns 200 with a list of { label, lat, lng } from Photon (base URL from config Geo:SuggestBaseUrl); q shorter than 3 chars fails validation with Geo.SuggestQueryTooShort (400).

On ANY upstream failure/timeout (4s, no retries), suggest returns 200 with an EMPTY list and logs Warning with Reason=GeoUpstreamUnavailable — it never returns 5xx so the order form is never blocked (context 11).

GET /api/v1/geo/route?fromLat&fromLng&toLat&toLng is DispatcherOnly, returns 200 { distanceMeters, durationSeconds, estimatedPriceCzk } (F-03: server-priced estimate — the endpoint injects TaxiDbContext, loads the caller's fleet default enabled Tariff via AsNoTracking projection resolved by the tenant query filter, and computes estimatedPriceCzk = max(MinimumFareCzk, BaseFareCzk + PerKmCzk * distanceKm) rounded to integer CZK; distanceMeters/durationSeconds come from OSRM public, base URL from config Geo:RouteBaseUrl). estimatedPriceCzk is null when no enabled default tariff exists — keeps tariff math server-side and Dispatcher-accessible without exposing the FleetAdminOnly tariff endpoint.
On route upstream failure/timeout returns 502 with AddError(Geo.RouteUnavailable); the client renders no price (order creation still proceeds).

The typed IGeoProvider/PhotonOsrmGeoProvider HttpClient is registered inside GeoFeatureConfiguration.AddFeatureDependencies (verified auto-invoked by AddFeatureConfigurations) so Program.cs is NOT edited; tests inject a fake IGeoProvider so no network call occurs.

Suggest touches zero tenant data (no isolation test); route now reads the Tariff table (tenant-filtered) so it DOES carry a tenant-isolation test (Route_UsesCallersFleetDefaultTariff) — documented in work-items Assumption 4 (amended for F-03).

Suggest_ValidQuery_ReturnsLabelledCoords, Suggest_UpstreamThrows_Returns200EmptyList, Suggest_NonDispatcher_Returns403, SuggestValidator_QueryTooShort_FailsWithCode, Route_ValidCoords_ReturnsDistanceDurationAndServerPrice, Route_NoDefaultTariff_ReturnsNullPrice, Route_UsesCallersFleetDefaultTariff (tenant isolation), and Route_UpstreamThrows_Returns502WithCode pass.

work_items.title: PATCH /orders/{id} partial edit (New/Assigned only, Updated event, optimistic-concurrency aware) + expose Order.Version in detail/realtime DTOs
work_items.goal: Dispatcher-only partial edit of an order (address/coords/time/note/passengers), allowed only in New/Assigned, writing one Updated OrderEvent, client-version-aware for optimistic concurrency, publishing OrderChanged after commit. Also exposes Order.Version in the detail + realtime payloads (F-01) so the client can load a version to send back on PATCH and reconcile realtime.
acceptance_criteria: F-01: Order.Version is projected into the frontend-visible detail + realtime payloads. Add Version (int) to OrderDetailDto (as the last positional param, XML-documented) and populate it in BOTH construction sites — OrderDetailMapper.ToDto (feeds the 8 transition endpoints) and the inline new OrderDetailDto(...) in GetOrderEndpoint. Add Version to OrderChangedDto and its From(order) projection. OrderSummaryDto stays lean (list rows do not carry version). So GET /orders/{id} returns version and the OrderChanged realtime payload carries version — this is what A2's client-version PATCH and B8's 'send the loaded version' depend on.
OrderEventType gains an Updated member (string-stored enum — no migration, mirrors the UserRole.System precedent in CLAUDE.md project facts).

PATCH /api/v1/orders/{id} is DispatcherOnly, edits pickup/dropoff (address+coords), scheduledAt, note, passengers when the order status is New or Assigned; writes exactly one Updated OrderEvent; publishes OrderChanged only after commit.

The request carries the client-loaded version; when req.Version != order.Version the endpoint returns 409 with AddError(Order.StaleVersion) BEFORE writing (client-version-aware, per Assumption 6); on a successful edit the endpoint increments order.Version before SaveChangesAsync (EF does NOT auto-increment the concurrency token — CLAUDE.md project fact) so a subsequent stale drawer is detected; a concurrent EF concurrency-token conflict on save is the 409 backstop.

Editing an order whose status is not New/Assigned returns 409 with AddError(Order.NotEditable); a not-found or cross-tenant order returns a no-leak 404; validation (e.g. dropoff address without coords) returns 400.

GetOrder_ReturnsCurrentVersion (F-01 — asserts OrderDetailDto.Version equals order.Version), Update_NewOrder_ChangesFieldsAndWritesUpdatedEvent, Update_StaleClientVersion_Returns409, Update_InProgressOrder_Returns409NotEditable, Update_CrossTenantOrder_Returns404, Update_NonDispatcher_Returns403, and UpdateOrderValidator_DropoffAddressWithoutCoords_FailsWithCode pass.

work_items.title: Driver status override + first AuditLog write + expose lastLat/lastLng in GET /drivers
work_items.goal: POST /drivers/{id}/status — DispatcherOnly manual override (Free/Busy/Offline) for phone-only drivers; writes the first AuditLog row, publishes DriverStatusChanged, and never touches any Order. Forced Offline mirrors the sanctioned StalePositionJob path. Also extends DriverSummaryDto + the GET /drivers projection with lastLat/lastLng (F-02) so the board has a REST source for distance-sort (B4) and initial map markers (B7).
acceptance_criteria: F-02: DriverSummaryDto gains lastLat (double?) and lastLng (double?) — additive, XML-documented — and the GET /drivers projection in ListDriversEndpoint populates them from Driver.LastLat/LastLng (both already exist on the Driver entity). lastPositionAt is ALREADY present on the DTO (verified) and is unchanged. This gives B4 distance-sort and B7 initial markers a REST source; markers with a null lastLat/lastLng render at no position until the first DriverPositionChanged event.

POST /api/v1/drivers/{id}/status is DispatcherOnly and accepts a target DriverStatus of Free, Busy, or Offline (EnRoute rejected with 400 Driver.InvalidOverrideStatus); the driver is resolved via the tenant query filter so a cross-tenant/absent driver returns a no-leak 404.

The override writes exactly one AuditLog row { Entity=Driver, Action=StatusOverride, EntityId=driverId, ActorUserId=caller, Diff=jsonb {old,new}, At=now, FleetId } — this is the first AuditLog write in the system and SUPERSEDES decisions.md assumption 9 (must be re-documented in decisions.md).

Forcing Offline mirrors StalePositionJob/GoOfflineEndpoint: Status=Offline, CurrentVehicleId=null, close the open DriverShift (EndedAt=now); the endpoint NEVER loads or mutates any Order (truthful-fallback, principle 7).
After a successful override the endpoint publishes DriverStatusChangedAsync(driverId, fleetId, newStatus, ct); it never publishes OrderChanged.

ListDrivers_ProjectsLastLatLng (F-02 — asserts a driver with a known LastLat/LastLng surfaces them in DriverSummaryDto), Override_ToBusy_SetsStatusAndWritesAuditLog (AC #5), Override_BusyDriverToOffline_ClosesShiftAndLeavesActiveOrderUntouched, Override_PublishesDriverStatusChanged, Override_CrossTenantDriver_Returns404 (tenant isolation), and Override_InvalidStatus_Returns400 pass.

work_items.title: POST /staff/{id}/reset-password (FleetAdmin, one-time plaintext)
work_items.goal: FleetAdminOnly password reset returning a new temporary plaintext password exactly once, mirroring the CreateStaffEndpoint invite pattern; the plaintext is never logged.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/staff/{id}/reset-password is FleetAdminOnly; the target staff user is resolved via the tenant query filter so a cross-tenant/absent user returns a no-leak 404.

A new temporary password is generated with the same charset/length as CreateStaffEndpoint (RandomNumberGenerator.GetString, 16 chars, unambiguous charset), BCrypt-hashed (workFactor 11), stored on user.PasswordHash, and the plaintext is returned exactly once in the response.
The plaintext password never appears in logs (at most a masked marker per rules/logging.md#what-must-not-appear-in-logs).

ResetPassword_ReturnsNewTempPasswordOnce_AndUpdatesHash (asserts the new hash verifies against the returned plaintext and the plaintext is absent from captured logs), ResetPassword_CrossTenantUser_Returns404 (tenant isolation), and ResetPassword_NonFleetAdmin_Returns403 pass.

There is no write endpoint; the Fleet tab renders the auto-dispatch toggle disabled with a v1.1 hint (frontend, B10).
GetFleetSettings_FleetAdmin_ReturnsCombinedDto, GetFleetSettings_FleetAdminOfFleetB_SeesOnlyFleetBSettings (tenant isolation), and GetFleetSettings_NonFleetAdmin_Returns403 pass.

work_items.title: Board layout + New order form

acceptance_criteria: The New order form has the exact field order and one tab-stop each (Phone, Name, Pickup, Dropoff, When, Passengers, Note); F2 focuses Phone from anywhere; Enter submits from any field.
Clicking a quick chip fills the pickup field with coordinates directly (no geo call); pickup/dropoff typing triggers debounced geo/suggest autocomplete.

A live price preview shows the server's estimatedPriceCzk from GET /geo/route when a route is computable (F-03 — no client-side tariff math); it is simply absent — not an error — when geo/route returns 502 OR when estimatedPriceCzk is null (no default tariff).
On submit the form clears and focus returns to Phone; the board renders at 1280x720 with no horizontal scroll (AC #6).

AC #7 parity green; useRouteEstimate.test.ts (renders estimatedPriceCzk when present; renders nothing on 502 and on null price), quick-chip fill logic, and testing-library tests for Enter-submit / F2-focus / clear-and-refocus pass.

work_items.goal: Middle column: sections (Nove/Prirazene/Probihajici/Naplanovane/Dokoncene dnes), order cards with all fields and a 2-min red timer, and Assign (inline driver picker sorted by distance, free first) / Reassign / Cancel (reason from list) / Detail actions with optimistic update and 409 reconcile.

A New order's elapsed-since-creation timer turns red after 2 minutes.

A 409 on any action shows 'Objednavku mezitim zmenil nekdo jiny' and refreshes the card (no silent overwrite).

work_items.title: SignalR realtime: events, optimistic + 409 reconcile, disconnect banner, sound
work_items.goal: Wire the @microsoft/signalr client to /hubs/fleet (JWT via access_token query string) for OrderChanged/DriverStatusChanged/DriverPositionChanged with optimistic updates + 409 reconcile, a disconnect banner with backoff reconnect + refetch, and a persisted-mute notification sound.
acceptance_criteria: OrderChanged moves a card between sections without a page reload; DriverStatusChanged updates driver pills; DriverPositionChanged is exposed for the map (B7). JWT is passed via the access_token query string per the hub contract (context 10).

On disconnect a yellow Czech banner 'Offline - zobrazuji posledni znamy stav' appears, server-requiring actions are disabled, and on reconnect the lists refetch; reconnection uses exponential backoff.
A short notification sound plays on a new App-source order and on a driver decline/timeout; the header mute toggle persists across reloads.
AC #7 parity green; reconnectBackoff.test.ts (capped exponential schedule), eventReducer.test.ts (OrderChanged updates the cached order; 409 triggers refetch), and a mute-persistence test pass.

work_items.title: Map: Leaflet driver markers + pickup pins + highlight

acceptance_criteria: Initial driver markers render from the GET /drivers lastLat/lastLng (A3, F-02); a driver with a null position is simply not placed until its first DriverPositionChanged event, and a marker tolerates a null heading (renders a neutral/non-directional icon) until the first position event supplies one. Subsequent live updates are fed by DriverPositionChanged (B6), with redraw throttled to 1s.
Pickup pins render for New/Assigned orders; clicking a pin highlights the corresponding card and clicking a card highlights the pin.
The map toggles to replace the middle column and becomes a 4th panel at viewport width >=1600.
AC #7 parity green; markerThrottle.test.ts (>=1 update/s coalesced), driverMarker.test.ts (icon by status/heading), and a highlight-mapping test pass.

work_items.title: Playwright E2E (create+assign AC#1, realtime AC#2) + API-run harness
work_items.goal: The Playwright suite proving AC #1 (create+assign <=6 interactions) and AC #2 (realtime card move on driver accept) against the real API + Postgres + seed, with a concrete compose-Postgres + dotnet-run harness. Depends on all Lane A WIs because the harness boots the shared working tree.
acceptance_criteria: playwright.config.ts uses a webServer array (or globalSetup): docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up db, then dotnet run --project api/src/Taxi.Api --environment Development with Seed__Enabled=true against the compose Postgres, waiting on /health/ready; then Vite at http://localhost:5173 (matches the API CORS default). @playwright/test is pinned to the conductor's prefetched Chromium version.

create-assign.spec.ts: from a fresh login, create an order with phone + pickup (via a quick chip) + ASAP in <=6 UI interactions, then assign it to a free driver; scripted time excluding network < 20 s (AC #1).

realtime.spec.ts: a helper logs in as driver1@demo.local/Demo1234! via API, goes online (POST /drivers/me/online), and after the dispatcher assigns, accepts (POST /orders/{id}/accept); the card moves to Probihajici without a page reload within 1 s (AC #2).

Secondary assertions where cheap: driver override pill change (A3), drawer edit via PATCH (A2), reset-password reveal (A4), fleet-settings read (A5), map marker move on a position push (AC #3), and a viewport 1280x720 assertion that the board has no horizontal scroll (AC #6 — vitest cannot measure layout, so this is proven here).

docs/decisions.md gains the UC-002 assumptions 1-14 (per DoD #6), explicitly including: the assumption-9 supersession (AuditLog is now written by A3's driver-status override, override semantics vs decisions.md assumption #9 remains flagged), and assumption 14 (F-05a — customer name auto-fill from past orders is DEFERRED to UC-006: no backend lookup exists and none is added in this UC); docs/api.md is regenerated by running the full dotnet test after A1-A5 land.
DEMO.md documents the manual npx lighthouse accessibility run on the board (AC #8, best-effort, non-blocking) and how to boot the compose+dotnet-run harness for a manual smoke check.

notes: UC-002 = 5 Lane A (api) WIs + 11 Lane B (web) WIs = 16 total. REVISION (round 2, F-01..F-05 resolved). Array is topologically ordered and acyclic. Lane A is NO LONGER fully parallel: F-04 serializes the three ErrorCodes.cs-touching WIs into a chain A1->A2->A3 (each appends its own const block to ErrorCodes.cs; the dependency edge removes the silent lost-update risk of concurrent edits to the same file). A4 and A5 keep empty depends_on and stay parallel (verified: neither touches ErrorCodes.cs -- A4 files_touched is Staff/ResetPassword + its test, A5 is Fleet feature + its test). B1..B11 form a strict chain; B11 additionally depends on A1-A5. Complexity scale XS/S/M/L (no XL) per the UC-001 handoff shape. Each WI carries a lane field (api|web). verification.tool enum extended for this UC: dotnet-test | dotnet-build | npm-lint | npm-tsc | vitest | playwright. verification.filter (dotnet-test only) keeps the FullyQualifiedName~ prefix per the UC-001 convention and uses single-token namespace fragments (Taxi.Api.Tests.<Area>); the npm-*/vitest/playwright tools take no filter (the filter charset excludes '/', so no path fragments are used). LANE INDEPENDENCE: Lane A never edits the shared composition root Program.cs — verified that Program.cs already calls AddFeatureConfigurations (Common/Features/FeatureConfigurationExtensions.cs), which reflects over every IFeatureConfiguration and invokes AddFeatureDependencies, so A1's geo HttpClient registers inside GeoFeatureConfiguration; A5's Fleet feature ships its own FleetFeatureConfiguration. Lane A shared-file edits and serialization (F-04): A1, A2, and A3 each append a distinct const block to the shared Common/ErrorCodes.cs (A1: Geo.RouteUnavailable/Geo.SuggestQueryTooShort; A2: Order.NotEditable/Order.StaleVersion; A3: Driver.InvalidOverrideStatus). Rather than rely on the developers to only-append (a discipline that fails silently -> lost update), these three WIs are SERIALIZED via depends_on A1->A2->A3 so only one edits ErrorCodes.cs at a time; the const additions are still disjoint, so each WI merely appends after the previous landed. A2 also adds OrderEventType.Updated (string enum, no migration, per the UserRole.System precedent) and, per F-01, adds Version to OrderDetailDto (both construction sites: OrderDetailMapper.ToDto feeding the 8 transition endpoints, plus the inline new OrderDetailDto(...) in GetOrderEndpoint) and to OrderChangedDto.From; OrderSummaryDto stays lean. A3 also adds, per F-02, lastLat/lastLng to DriverSummaryDto + the ListDriversEndpoint projection (Driver.LastLat/LastLng already exist; lastPositionAt was already on the DTO). A4/A5 touch neither ErrorCodes.cs nor any shared file and run parallel to the A1->A2->A3 chain. Staging discipline (autonomous, single working tree): Lane A stages api/ paths only, Lane B stages web/ paths only; neither commits. KEY DECISIONS: (geo failure) suggest 200-empty-list on upstream failure so the order form is never blocked, route 502 with Geo.RouteUnavailable; provider Photon for suggest (Nominatim 1req/s cap is hostile to autocomplete), OSRM public for route; base URLs are config keys for later self-hosting; 4s timeout no retries. (F-03 tariff source for price preview) DECISION: extend A1's GET /geo/route to return a SERVER-priced estimate { distanceMeters, durationSeconds, estimatedPriceCzk } rather than add a Dispatcher-readable tariff endpoint -- route injects TaxiDbContext, loads the caller's fleet default enabled Tariff via the tenant query filter, computes estimatedPriceCzk = max(MinimumFareCzk, BaseFareCzk + PerKmCzk*km) integer CZK, null when no default tariff. This keeps tariff math server-side and dispatcher-accessible without exposing the FleetAdminOnly tariff data. Consequence: route now reads tenant data, so Assumption 4 is amended (suggest still touches no tenant data; route gains a tenant-isolation test) and A1 gains ef-core rule citations; B3's former client-side priceEstimate.ts calc is REMOVED (client renders the server's estimatedPriceCzk; preview absent on 502 OR null price). (PATCH concurrency) client sends loaded version -> 409 Order.StaleVersion on mismatch before write, EF token backstop; non-editable status -> 409 Order.NotEditable. (override semantics) Free/Busy/Offline allowed regardless of active order (principle 7 truthful fallback); writes only the Driver row + first AuditLog row (Entity=Driver, Action=StatusOverride) + shift close on Offline (mirrors StalePositionJob write set: Status=Offline, CurrentVehicleId=null, close DriverShift); NEVER touches an Order; this SUPERSEDES decisions.md assumption 9 (AuditLog unwritten until 07) and must be re-documented in decisions.md. (settings endpoint) A5 added: GET /fleet/settings FleetAdminOnly read-only Fleet+FleetSettings DTO; no write endpoint (v1.1); quick chips stay hardcoded frontend constants. (F-01 version exposure) Order.Version exists as an int concurrency token but was projected into NO frontend-visible DTO; A2 now adds it to OrderDetailDto (GET /orders/{id}) and OrderChangedDto (realtime) so A2's client-version PATCH and B8's send-loaded-version work; summary DTO stays lean. (F-02 driver position source) GET /drivers omitted LastLat/LastLng; A3 adds them to DriverSummaryDto + projection (additive) so B4 distance-sort and B7 initial markers have a REST source; B7 markers tolerate null heading/position until the first DriverPositionChanged event. (F-05 orphan behaviors) (a) customer name auto-fill from past orders: DEFERRED to UC-006 -- no backend lookup exists and none is added here (documented as assumption 14 in decisions.md, recorded by B11); (b) new-order 3s highlight: assigned to B4 (NOT B3) because B3 creates no order cards -- OrderCard/OrdersColumn are B4-owned files, so a highlight AC on B3 would target a component that does not yet exist.
